preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= n and 1 <= b <= n for a, b in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices numbered between 1 and n inclusive.
The number of vertex values is exactly n.
Each vertex value is between -1,000,000,000 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The return value is the minimum number of moves required to make all vertex values zero.
